solar.ne_note: Partially visible from New England — but a tiny bite: Boston maximum magnitude ~0.086, 9:28–10:58 AM EST (max 10:12 AM).
solar.regions: Annular: Ecuador, Peru, Colombia, Brazil, French Guiana, Portugal, Spain. Partial includes eastern North America.

solar.ne_note: Visible from New England — partial on the US East Coast, maximum magnitude ~0.506. The best solar eclipse for New England through 2032.
